claims.text: Son Bunyola is on Mallorca's north-west coast in the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Tramuntana Mountains.

findings.quote: located on the island’s stunning north-west coast in the spectacular UNESCO World Heritage-listed Tramuntana Mountains

claims.text: The hotel is set in a 16th-century finca, or manor house, at the heart of the estate.

findings.quote: Sitting at the heart of the estate is the 16th-century Finca - or manor house

claims.text: The restoration was done with Mallorcan architects Gras Reynes Architecture Studio and interior designer Rialto Living, using traditional and local materials.

findings.quote: Working with Mallorcan architects Gras Reynes Architecture Studio and interior designer Rialto Living, using traditional and local materials was at the heart of the hotel’s design.

claims.text: Some suites have private terraces with sweeping views.

findings.quote: to suites with private terraces boasting soaring views

claims.text: The estate includes three standalone villas: Sa Punta de S'Aguila, Sa Terra Rotja and Son Balagueret, which can be hired year-round.

findings.quote: three standalone luxury villas - Sa Punta de S’Aguila, Sa Terra Rotja and Son Balagueret
Our three luxury Mallorca villas can be hired year-round

claims.text: Son Balagueret villa has a 13th-century turret and a central courtyard.

findings.quote: Spread over three floors with a quirky 13th century turret and central courtyard

claims.text: Guests can swim in the pool and do yoga and tennis, and the mountain landscape suits hiking and cycling.

findings.quote: unwind with a dip in the pool, or a spot of yoga and tennis, all while enjoying the awe-inspiring views, but the mountainous landscape is also ideal for hiking and cycling

claims.text: From the pebble beach below the hotel, guests can swim, kayak and picnic.

findings.quote: From the empty pebble beach below the hotel (watch out for nudists) you can swim, kayak, and picnic

claims.text: Sa Terrassa serves Mediterranean cuisine with sea views.

findings.quote: Sa Terrassa, where Mediterranean cuisine is served alongside breathtaking sea views

claims.text: Mallorcan dishes are made from produce grown in the estate's gardens and orchards.

findings.quote: savour authentic Mallorcan dishes crafted from fresh produce grown in the estate’s gardens and orchards

claims.text: Son Bunyola was awarded a MICHELIN Key by The MICHELIN Guide in 2025 and 2026.

findings.quote: Awarded a MICHELIN Key by The MICHELIN Guide 2026 & 2025

claims.text: One bedroom, Room 1, is designed for wheelchair users.

findings.quote: One of the bedrooms—Room 1—has been designed for wheelchair users

claims.text: The estate has three miles of unspoilt coastline, with olive groves and vineyards.

findings.quote: With three miles of unspoilt coastline, rugged shores, olive groves, vineyards

claims.text: The original towers of the main house have been turned into two Tower Suites with vineyard and mountain views.

findings.quote: The original towers in the main house have been transformed into two Tower Suites, showcasing vineyard views and the mountains beyond.

claims.text: The terrace looks down over a small village to the bay and the Sa Foradada rock formation.

findings.quote: an extensive terrace looking down over a small village to the bay below and the striking Sa Foradada rock formation

claims.text: The pool sits on the historic terrace, and the former olive press has been restored.

findings.quote: The former olive press has lovingly been restored, and the historic terrace is now home to the pool.

claims.text: Sa Punta de S'Aguila villa is built into the landscape in traditional Mallorcan style, with panoramic sea and mountain views.

findings.quote: With stunning panoramic sea and mountain views, this beautiful villa built into the landscape in traditional Mallorcan style

claims.text: The spa is small, run by locally based Gaia Natural Products, with a short menu of treatments using island oils.

findings.quote: The hotel spa is small but very accomplished, run by locally based Gaia Natural Products with a short menu of treatments using island oils.

claims.text: There are not a lot of facilities for children, though there is a smaller pool by the main one.

findings.quote: While there aren’t a lot of facilities for children there’s a smaller pool by the main one

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location requires a car for exploring.
